title: Zesty Flaky Moroccan Almond Tagine
description: A light and flaky Moroccan dish featuring demerara sugar and almonds, this tagine is a perfect paleo-friendly option for a weeknight dinner. The combination of resinous spices and sweet demerara sugar creates a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced almonds, demerara sugar, and spices.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the almond mixture to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and pour in the chicken broth.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the almonds are lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
